hints.title: Identify Bounding Boxes
hints.text: Each color must cover its entire bounding box from its minimum to maximum row and column.

hints.title: Form Dependency Edges
hints.text: If another color appears inside the bounding box of color A, that other color must be printed after color A.

hints.title: Cycle Detection via Topological Sort
hints.text: Build a directed graph where an edge from color A to color B means A must precede B. If the graph contains no cycles, a valid printing sequence exists.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: C is the number of distinct colors (up to 60)
m and n are grid dimensions
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all permutations of colors leads to 60 factorial possibilities, which is astronomically intractable.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: We spend O(C^2) space to build the color dependency graph, enabling linear-time cycle detection via Kahn topological sort.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that any cell inside color A bounding box displaying color B imposes a strict precedence A -> B.
